findings.description: This subnet automatically assigns public IPv4 addresses and is associated with a route table whose default route leads to an Internet Gateway. Workloads launched here can be Internet-reachable unless separately constrained.

This subnet automatically assigns public IPv4 addresses and is associated with a route table whose default route leads to an Internet Gateway. The portal instance is launched here, creating a public network placement.
The standalone EBS volume does not explicitly enable encryption. Its contents are not assured encrypted at rest by this configuration.
User data embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key. These static credentials are exposed in source configuration and instance user data and may be used by anyone who obtains them.
The instance does not explicitly configure root EBS encryption. Encryption is therefore not assured by the configuration.
TCP port 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0. Because the attached instance is in a publicly routed subnet with automatic public IP assignment, arbitrary Internet hosts can attempt SSH access.
The bucket receiving VPC flow logs does not explicitly configure server-side encryption. Sensitive network metadata is not assured encrypted at rest by this configuration.
The snapshot is derived from an EBS volume that is not explicitly encrypted, so encryption of the backup is not assured by this configuration.
